_meta.source: Figma file yIltK4T4z2tlZWjaMqlZTW — HRDS Definition · HRDS Tokens collection
_meta.note: Every value below is the verbatim dark-mode hex of an HRDS variable. Values marked `TBD:figma` are real HRDS tokens whose hex was not present in the Figma description text and must be resolved (Figma desktop selection, REST API, or screenshot of the token preview frame).

background.desc: Outermost page/app background. <body>, root layout, full-bleed surfaces.

foreground.desc: Default text/icon color on the main background.

border.desc: Default choice for most border needs.

muted.desc: Subtle secondary background for low-emphasis surfaces. Note: HRDS dark-mode value is #39393d (matches --border).

muted-foreground.desc: De-emphasised text: captions, placeholders, helper text.

accent.desc: Subtle hover/focus background behind interactive list items.

ring.desc: Focus ring on keyboard-focused interactive elements.

card.desc: Contained, elevated block of content (job/profile cards, panels).

popover.desc: Floating surfaces: dropdowns, command palette, date pickers, tooltips.

primary.desc: Primary CTA at rest. HR neon green. Used once per key flow.

outline-border.desc: Border for outline-style buttons at rest.

ghost-hover.desc: Ghost button background on hover. White at 10% opacity in dark mode.

ghost-active.desc: Ghost button pressed. White at 5% opacity in dark mode.

info.desc: Solid info blue. Filled info badges, banners.

success.desc: Solid success green. Same hex in light and dark.

warning.desc: Solid error/danger red. HRDS calls this 'warning' but it is the destructive/error red, NOT amber. For VS Code's amber warning UI, use `states/caution`.

warning-foreground.desc: Text/icon within warning (=error red) tinted containers (dark mode).

caution.desc: Solid caution yellow. Use for VS Code's editorWarning, inputValidation.warningBorder, statusBarItem.warningBackground, etc. Same hex in light and dark.

neutral-foreground.desc: Text/icon inside neutral chips and badges.

grey.desc: Solid mid-grey. Muted/inactive badges, neutral chips.

grey-alt.desc: Light grey tint for container backgrounds in dark mode.

grey-accent.desc: Mid-tone grey accent for interactive elements. White in dark mode (contrast against grey-alt container).

grey-foreground.desc: Text/icon within grey-tinted containers. White in dark mode.

cyan.desc: Solid cyan. Data-viz accents, secondary brand highlights.

cyan-accent.desc: Mid-tone cyan accent for interactive elements.

purple.desc: Solid purple. HR's AI/ML accent color.

purple-accent.desc: Mid-tone purple accent for interactive elements.

fuscia.desc: Solid fuchsia accent. Dark-mode hex differs from light (#c4187a).

orange.desc: Solid orange accent. Same hex in both modes.

border-alpha.desc: Subtle transparent border for glass/frosted surfaces. ~15% opacity white in dark mode.

border-heavy-alpha.desc: Stronger transparent border. ~30% opacity white in dark mode.

accent-alpha.desc: Transparent accent at ~30% opacity white in dark mode. (HRDS labels this row '--accent-medium-alpha' on the mapping board; the underlying variable name is --accent-alpha.)
